_note: Closed assetRole registry built from a grep of real /asset usage in src/**/*.jsx. NOT FOR PUBLIC REDISTRIBUTION: the source is a real company's site; the logos, felt-character art, product screenshots and photographs belong to Merlin or third parties. Moved to assets/asset-roles.json (BASELINE R3 location). Every role has a closed availability (clone-only | generation-safe | blocked-for-generation), generationSafeSubstitutes and generatedModeGuidance.

generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Use only a registered exact file (assetRef reuse:<id>) or the neutral placeholder. Never regenerate, redraw, recolour or approximate it.
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate: Real third-party / real-person / proprietary-capture content. Use a registered exact file only for an internal, licensed reproduction, otherwise use the neutral placeholder. Never generate a logo, face, screenshot, photograph or recording that imitates it.
generationPolicies.may-generate-new: Generic or decorative; a generator may create a new original asset (assetRef generate:<short brief>) or reuse a registered one.

pinnedPoliciesNote: Load-bearing: verify_all.py and the adversarial suite pin each role to EXACTLY this policy (membership in the 3-value enum is necessary but not sufficient; e.g. flipping logo.third-party-wordmark to may-generate-new is still a valid enum value and must fail).

refKinds.reuse: reuse:<assetId> - id must exist in `assets` and its registered role must equal the declared assetRole
refKinds.generate: generate:<brief> - allowed only for may-generate-new roles
refKinds.placeholder: placeholder:neutral - always allowed; renders a neutral empty box/label, the safe choice for must-not-fabricate roles
refKinds.user: user:<id> - an operator/user-supplied file; allowed only for media.user-supplied

hardBans: Do not reproduce, redraw, trace or approximate any real third-party logo (Notion, Salesforce, Harvard, HubSpot, McKinsey, Qatar Airways, DoorDash, Instacart, Ashby, Google, Slack, Adobe, Zoom, Apple).
Do not reproduce the Merlin logo, dock icon, face mark or felt mascot art, and do not generate look-alike felt-character scenes.
Do not fabricate photographs, names or likenesses of real people (blog author, stock-photo subjects).
Do not fabricate product screenshots, macOS UI captures or recordings.
This design-repo is not for public redistribution. Do not publish the repository or the zip.

availabilityValues.clone-only: The source's own (first-party) asset: allowed only in mode=clone PageSpecs (faithful reconstruction); rejected in mode=generation.
availabilityValues.generation-safe: Allowed in both modes; contains nothing that identifies or reproduces the source.
availabilityValues.blocked-for-generation: Third-party or real-person / OS-capture content: allowed only in mode=clone for an internal, licensed reproduction; rejected in mode=generation.
